disagreements.issue: The fixture explicitly says developed elsewhere, yet no local creator contribution is evidenced. Both prohibit current regional publication; review versus exclusion and known nonlocal development versus unresolved possible local contribution need a common state definition.
disagreements.proposed_resolution: Separate evidence state from eligibility: original development elsewhere is known; a local creator contribution remains unsupported; regional eligibility is false on supplied evidence, and any continuing candidate is held for creator-role review. Do not assert that no local contribution can ever exist.

Use not_applicable for work: the fixture targets a person profile and supplies no specific work. Keep current regional creator ineligible and residential address excluded. This narrows an overbroad Astra label.

Use not_assessed/unknown for the person. The artifact lacks healthcare purpose; the case does not establish the whole professional history. Artifact relevance remains negative. This narrows an overbroad Astra label.
